lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical line segments; the anterior three segments exhibit high contrast and wide spacing (~12-15% of torso width), while the posterior nine segments are narrow, low-contrast, and more densely packed.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A prominent Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second major anterior line, splitting at approximately the upper 20% of the torso height near the dorsal ridge; a merging of two thin lines occurs in the mid-flank region of the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most 6 line segments are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe; the first anterior line segment terminates prematurely at the shoulder-neck transition.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are located on the posterior flank, positioned in a low-density triangular grouping above the junction of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral lyrate curvature; horns emerge at a posterior angle of approximately 40 degrees from the skull, curving laterally before turning medially at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.55 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 18% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white facial chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower mandible/cheek; prominent white dorsal mane extending along the spine.
